A systematic meta-analysis of genetic, regional, and production determinants of global pork quality

Code and model outputs - Aspartic Acid

1 Loading packages and data

## Load the packages
library(metafor)
library(orchaRd)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(openxlsx)
library(MuMIn)
library(glue)
library(rlang)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
## Load the functions from the script file
source("functions.R")
## Load the data
data_Asp <- read.csv("Asp.csv")

## Convert columns to appropriate numeric types
data_Asp$Mean <- as.numeric(data_Asp$Mean)
data_Asp$SD <- as.numeric(data_Asp$SD)
data_Asp$Sample <- as.numeric(data_Asp$Sample)
data_Asp$Age <- as.numeric(data_Asp$Age)
data_Asp$Weight <- as.numeric(data_Asp$Weight)
data_Asp$Digestible_energy <- as.numeric(data_Asp$Digestible_energy)
data_Asp$Crude_protein <- as.numeric(data_Asp$Crude_protein)
data_Asp$Crude_fat <- as.numeric(data_Asp$Crude_fat)
data_Asp$Crude_fiber <- as.numeric(data_Asp$Crude_fiber)
data_Asp$Ash <- as.numeric(data_Asp$Ash)
data_Asp$Lys <- as.numeric(data_Asp$Lys)
data_Asp$Met_and_Cys <- as.numeric(data_Asp$Met_and_Cys)
data_Asp$Thr <- as.numeric(data_Asp$Thr)
data_Asp$Try <- as.numeric(data_Asp$Try)
data_Asp$Val <- as.numeric(data_Asp$Val)
data_Asp$Dry_matter <- as.numeric(data_Asp$Dry_matter)
data_Asp$Ca <- as.numeric(data_Asp$Ca)
data_Asp$P <- as.numeric(data_Asp$P)
data_Asp$Na <- as.numeric(data_Asp$Na)

## Convert columns to factor types
data_Asp$Position <- factor(data_Asp$Position)
data_Asp$Breed <- factor(data_Asp$Breed)
data_Asp$Class <- factor(data_Asp$Class)
data_Asp$Sex <- factor(data_Asp$Sex)
data_Asp$Region <- factor(data_Asp$Region)
data_Asp$Aim <- factor(data_Asp$Aim)
data_Asp$Multiple_breeds <- factor(data_Asp$Multiple_breeds)

## Calculate variance (rVar)
# rVar is the square of the standard error (SD/sqrt(Sample))
data_Asp$rVar <- (data_Asp$SD/sqrt(data_Asp$Sample))^2

2 Testing random effects

## run VCV matrix
VCV_Asp_AllData <- make_VCV_matrix(data_Asp, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")

## Null model with vcv matrix:
# This model includes random effects for RowID (observation-level) and StudyID.
null_Asp_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_Asp_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_Asp, method = "ML")
summary(null_Asp_mod) #511.1371            
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 231; method: ML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
## -252.5685  1561.4916   511.1371   521.4643   511.2428   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0402  0.2006    231     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  3.8533  1.9630    112     no  StudyID 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 230) = 7713678.0000, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub      
##   2.7656  0.1865  14.8279  <.0001  2.4000  3.1312  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## Test whether Region should be a random effect:
# Adds Region as a random effect to the null model structure.
Re_Asp_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_Asp_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID,
                                     ~1 |Region),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_Asp, method = "ML")
summary(Re_Asp_mod) #500.0473

## Full model with fixed effects for Position, Breed, Region, and Class
Asp_full_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_Asp_AllData, 
                      mods = ~Position + Breed + Region + Class,
                      random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID),
                      sparse = TRUE,
                      data = data_Asp, method = "ML")

R2_Full <- round(r2_ml(Asp_full_mod)*100, 2)
anova(Asp_full_mod,null_Asp_mod)
## 
##          df      AIC      BIC     AICc    logLik      LRT   pval           QE 
## Full    116 356.6740 755.9945 594.7793  -62.3370                    8005.2838 
## Reduced   3 511.1371 521.4643 511.2428 -252.5685 380.4630 <.0001 7713678.0000
## Model with Position as a fixed effect
Asp_Position_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_Asp_AllData, 
                          mods = ~Position,
                          random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                        ~1 |StudyID),
                          sparse = TRUE,
                          data = data_Asp, method = "ML")
R2_Position <-round(r2_ml(Asp_Position_mod)*100, 2)
anova(Asp_Position_mod,null_Asp_mod)
## 
##         df      AIC      BIC     AICc    logLik     LRT   pval           QE 
## Full    11 495.5084 533.3750 496.7139 -236.7542                6819397.1386 
## Reduced  3 511.1371 521.4643 511.2428 -252.5685 31.6286 0.0001 7713678.0000
## Model with Breed as a fixed effect
Asp_Breed_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_Asp_AllData, 
                       mods = ~Breed,
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_Asp, method = "ML")
R2_Breed <- round(r2_ml(Asp_Breed_mod)*100, 2)
anova(Asp_Breed_mod,null_Asp_mod)
## 
##         df      AIC      BIC     AICc    logLik      LRT   pval           QE

## Reduced  3 511.1371 521.4643 511.2428 -252.5685 119.7515 0.0233 7713678.0000
## Model with Region as a fixed effect
Asp_Region_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_Asp_AllData, 
                      mods = ~Region,
                      random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID),
                      sparse = TRUE,

R2_Region <- round(r2_ml(Asp_Region_mod)*100, 2) 
anova(Asp_Region_mod,null_Asp_mod)
## 
##         df      AIC      BIC     AICc    logLik     LRT   pval           QE 
## Full    26 483.5914 573.0942 490.4737 -215.7957                 201154.3028 
## Reduced  3 511.1371 521.4643 511.2428 -252.5685 73.5457 <.0001 7713678.0000
## Model with Class as a fixed effect
Asp_Class_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_Asp_AllData, 
                       mods = ~Class,
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_Asp, method = "ML")
R2_Class <- round(r2_ml(Asp_Class_mod)*100, 2)
anova(Asp_Class_mod,null_Asp_mod)
## 
##         df      AIC      BIC     AICc    logLik    LRT   pval           QE 
## Full     7 517.9260 542.0229 518.4282 -251.9630               7709914.7916 
## Reduced  3 511.1371 521.4643 511.2428 -252.5685 1.2110 0.8763 7713678.0000
## Create a table of R-squared values for models with moderators
R2_models_summary <- data.frame("Model" = c("Full",
                                     "Position",
                                     "Breed",
                                     "Region",
                                     "Class"),
                         "R2" = c(R2_Full[1],
                                  R2_Position[1],
                                  R2_Breed[1],
                                  R2_Region[1],
                                  R2_Class[1]))
R2_models_summary <- R2_models_summary %>% 
  transmute(Model = Model
            ,R2= round(R2,2))

colnames(R2_models_summary)[2] <- "$R^2(\\%)$"

R2_models_summary %>% 
  kable(format="html", escape=F, caption="Heterogeneity explained in the models with moderators") %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(c("hover", "condensed"), full_width = F)

## Refit with REML for reporting in Manuscript
REML_Asp_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_Asp_AllData, 
                     random = list(~1 | RowID,
                                   ~1 | StudyID,
                                   ~1 | Region,
                                   # ~1 | Breed, # Breed was not better than null in initial test
                                   ~1 | Position),
                        sparse = TRUE,
                        data = data_Asp, method = "REML")
summary(REML_Asp_mod)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 231; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
## -236.8586   473.7171   483.7171   500.9075   483.9850   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0317  0.1781    231     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  2.6418  1.6254    112     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  1.8205  1.3493     24     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4  0.2474  0.4974      9     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 230) = 7713678.0000, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se    zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub      
##   2.7848  0.4188  6.6503  <.0001  1.9641  3.6056  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
# Calculate I-squared values 
round(i2_ml(REML_Asp_mod), 2)
##    I2_Total    I2_RowID  I2_StudyID   I2_Region I2_Position 
##      100.00        0.67       55.71       38.39        5.22
# Calculate R-squared
round(r2_ml(REML_Asp_mod)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.00          99.33
## Generate orchard plot for the REML model
p_REML_Asp <- orchard_plot(REML_Asp_mod,
                               group = "StudyID",  
                               xlab = "Mean Aspartic acid",
                               cb = FALSE, 
                               angle = 0, 
                               legend.pos = "bottom.out", 
                               branch.size = 1.5) 

print(p_REML_Asp)

3 Meta-regression

3.1 Breed

## Filter data for breeds with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_Asp_B3 <- data_Asp %>%
  group_by(Breed) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered breed data
VCV_Asp_B3_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_Asp_B3, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_breed <- list(~1 | RowID,
                               ~1 | StudyID,
                               ~1 | Region,
                               ~1 | Position)

# Model with intercept
Br_VCV_REML_Asp_mod_int <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_Asp_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed,
  random = random_structure_breed,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_Asp_B3)

summary(Br_VCV_REML_Asp_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 116; method: REML)
## 
##   logLik  Deviance       AIC       BIC      AICc

## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor

## sigma^2.3  4.1623  2.0402     17     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4  1.3356  1.1557      5     no  Position

round(r2_ml(Br_VCV_REML_Asp_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           2.61          99.65
# Model without intercept for plotting
Br_VCV_REML_Asp_mod <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_Asp_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed -1,
  random = random_structure_breed,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_Asp_B3)
## Orchard plot for Breed moderator
p_Br_VCV_REML_Asp <- orchard_plot(Br_VCV_REML_Asp_mod, 
                                  mod = "Breed",  
                                  group = "StudyID",  
                                  xlab = "Mean Aspartic acid",
                                  cb = FALSE,
                                  angle = 0,
                                  legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                                  branch.size = 1.5)

print(p_Br_VCV_REML_Asp)

## Generate table of pairwise comparisons for Breed using all_models function
res_Asp_Br <- all_models(
  data        = data_Asp_B3,
  vcv         = VCV_Asp_B3_Data,
  yi_col      = "Mean",
  mod_name    = "Breed",
  random_list = random_structure_breed
)

3.3 Position

## Filter data for Position with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_Asp_P3 <- data_Asp %>%
  group_by(Position) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered Position data
VCV_Asp_P3_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_Asp_P3, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_position <- list(~1 | RowID,
                                  ~1 | StudyID,
                                  ~1 | Region)

# Model with intercept
Po_VCV_REML_Asp_mod_int <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_Asp_P3_Data,
  mods = ~ Position,
  random = random_structure_position,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_Asp_P3)

summary(Po_VCV_REML_Asp_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 223; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
## -221.4179   442.8359   454.8359   475.1976   455.2302   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0321  0.1793    223     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  2.5660  1.6019    109     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  1.7600  1.3267     23     no   Region 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 220) = 6819322.2739, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficients 2:3):
## F(df1 = 2, df2 = 220) = 0.2413, p-val = 0.7858
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##                            estimate      se     tval   df    pval    ci.lb   ci.ub      
## intrcpt                      3.1648  0.8449   3.7456  220  0.0002   1.4996  4.8300  *** 
## PositionLongissimus         -0.7270  1.2352  -0.5886  220  0.5568  -3.1613  1.7073      
## PositionLongissimus dorsi   -0.0076  0.8047  -0.0094  220  0.9925  -1.5935  1.5783      
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Po_VCV_REML_Asp_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.51          99.27
# Model without intercept for plotting
Po_VCV_REML_Asp_mod <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_Asp_P3_Data,
  mods = ~ Position -1,
  random = random_structure_position,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_Asp_P3)
## Orchard plot for Position moderator
p_Po_VCV_REML_Asp <- orchard_plot(Po_VCV_REML_Asp_mod, 
                                  mod = "Position",  
                                  group = "StudyID",  
                                  xlab = "Mean Aspartic acid", 
                                  cb = FALSE,
                                  angle = 0,
                                  legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                                  branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_Po_VCV_REML_Asp)

## Generate table of pairwise comparisons for Position
res_Asp_Po <- all_models(
  data        = data_Asp_P3,
  vcv         = VCV_Asp_P3_Data,
  yi_col      = "Mean",
  mod_name    = "Position",
  random_list = random_structure_position
)

3.6 Age

## Filter data for complete cases of Age
data_Asp_Age <- data_Asp[complete.cases(data_Asp$Age), ]

## Create VCV matrix for Age data
VCV_Asp_Age_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_Asp_Age, 
                                    V = "rVar", 
                                    cluster = "StudyID", 
                                    obs = "RowID")
## Define common random structure for continuous moderators
random_structure_continuous <- list(~1 | RowID,
                                    ~1 | StudyID,
                                    ~1 | Region, 
                                    ~1 | Position)

## Run meta-regression for Age
res_Asp_Age <- run_meta_ct(
  dat         = data_Asp_Age,          
  mod_var     = "Age",
  random_list = random_structure_continuous,
  plot_name   = "p_Asp_Age",     
  x_lab       = "Age (Days)",
  y_lab       = "Aspartic acid (%)"
)

## Generate summary table for Age models
mods_list_age <- attr(res_Asp_Age$best_model, "mods_list") 
aic_tab_age   <- res_Asp_Age$aic_table

tbl_Asp_Age <- model_summary_tbl(
  mods      = mods_list_age, 
  aic_tab   = aic_tab_age,
  lin_coef  = "mod_c",              
  quad_coef = "mod_c2"
)
## Display summary table for Age models
html_table_age <- tbl_Asp_Age %>% 
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")
print(html_table_age)

3.16 Met and Cys

## Filter data for complete cases of Methionine + Cysteine (Met_and_Cys)
data_Asp_MC <- data_Asp[complete.cases(data_Asp$Met_and_Cys), ]

## Create VCV matrix
VCV_Asp_MC_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_Asp_MC, 
                                    V = "rVar", 
                                    cluster = "StudyID", 
                                    obs = "RowID")
# 1. Data Preparation
data_Asp_MC <- data_Asp_MC %>%
  filter(!is.na(Met_and_Cys), !is.na(Mean), !is.na(rVar)) %>%
  mutate(
    mu     = mean(Met_and_Cys, na.rm = TRUE),
    MC_c   = Met_and_Cys - mu,
    MC_c2  = MC_c^2,
    Prec   = 1 / sqrt(rVar)
  )

VCV_Asp_MC_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(
  data_Asp_MC,
  V       = "rVar",
  cluster = "StudyID",
  obs     = "RowID"
)

# 2. Model Fitting & Selection
rand_layers <- list(~1|RowID, ~1|StudyID, ~1|Region, ~1|Position)
ctrl <- list(optimizer="optim", optmethod="BFGS", maxiter=2000, reltol=1e-8)

fit0 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_Asp_MC_Data, mods = ~1,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_Asp_MC,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)
fit1 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_Asp_MC_Data, mods = ~MC_c,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_Asp_MC,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)
fit2 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_Asp_MC_Data, mods = ~MC_c + MC_c2,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_Asp_MC,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)

ms_tab <- model.sel(list(fit0=fit0, fit1=fit1, fit2=fit2), rank="AICc")
print(ms_tab, digits=3)
## Model selection table 
##      (Int)     mods df  logLik AICc delta weight
## fit0     +           5 -18.630 49.9  0.00  0.789
## fit1     +      M_c  6 -18.620 53.1  3.19  0.160
## fit2     + M_c+M_c2  7 -18.001 55.3  5.47  0.051
## Abbreviations:
##  mods:  = '~1', M_c = '~MC_c', M_c+M_c2 = '~MC_c+MC_c2'
## Models ranked by AICc(x)
anova(fit0, fit1)
## 
##         df     AIC     BIC    AICc   logLik    LRT   pval         QE 
## Full     6 49.2402 57.4439 53.0583 -18.6201                9908.5625 
## Reduced  5 47.2591 54.0956 49.8678 -18.6295 0.0189 0.8906 10886.2785
anova(fit1, fit2)
## 
##         df     AIC     BIC    AICc   logLik    LRT   pval        QE 
## Full     7 50.0012 59.5723 55.3346 -18.0006               9227.9269 
## Reduced  6 49.2402 57.4439 53.0583 -18.6201 1.2389 0.2657 9908.5625
best_key <- rownames(ms_tab)[1]
best_mod <- switch(best_key,
                   fit0 = update(fit0, method="REML"),
                   fit1 = update(fit1, method="REML"),
                   fit2 = update(fit2, method="REML"))

# 3. Plotting Functions
plot_linear <- function(model, df) {
  mu   <- mean(df$Met_and_Cys, na.rm=TRUE)
  newdat <- data.frame(
    Met_and_Cys = seq(min(df$Met_and_Cys), max(df$Met_and_Cys), length.out=200)
  ) %>% mutate(
    MC_c = Met_and_Cys - mu
  )
  ci   <- predict(model, newmods=newdat$MC_c)
  newdat <- newdat %>% mutate(
    fit    = ci$pred,
    ci_lwr = ci$ci.lb,
    ci_upr = ci$ci.ub
  )
  beta1 <- coef(model)["MC_c"]
  p_val <- summary(model)$pval["MC_c"]
  R2m   <- r2_ml(model)["R2_marginal"]*100
  
  ggplot(df, aes(Met_and_Cys, Mean)) +
    geom_point(aes(size=Prec), shape=21, fill="grey65",
               colour="black", stroke=.25, alpha=.6) +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(.5,4), name="Precision\n(1/SE)") +
    geom_ribbon(data=newdat,
                aes(x=Met_and_Cys, ymin=ci_lwr, ymax=ci_upr),
                fill="grey85", alpha=.5, inherit.aes=FALSE) +
    geom_line(data=newdat,
              aes(x=Met_and_Cys, y=fit),
              colour="firebrick", linewidth=.9) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Na)+.03*diff(range(df$Na)),
             y=min(df$Mean)+.07*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("β = %.3f\nR² = %.2f%%\nP = %.3g",
                           beta1, R2m, p_val),
             colour="blue4", hjust=0, size=3.2) +
    labs(x="Na (% DM)", y="Aspartic acid (%)") +
    theme_classic(base_size=11) +
    theme(panel.border=element_rect(colour="black", fill=NA),
          legend.position=c(.98,.99),
          legend.justification=c(1,1))
}

plot_quadratic <- function(model, df) {
  mu   <- mean(df$Met_and_Cys, na.rm=TRUE)
  newdat <- data.frame(
    Met_and_Cys = seq(min(df$Met_and_Cys), max(df$Met_and_Cys), length.out=200)
  ) %>% mutate(
    MC_c  = Met_and_Cys - mu,
    MC_c2 = MC_c^2
  )
  ci   <- predict(model, newmods=as.matrix(newdat[,c("MC_c","MC_c2")]))
  newdat <- newdat %>% mutate(
    fit    = ci$pred,
    ci_lwr = ci$ci.lb,
    ci_upr = ci$ci.ub
  )
  b1    <- coef(model)["MC_c"]
  b2    <- coef(model)["MC_c2"]
  x_opt <- -b1/(2*b2) + mu
  p_val <- summary(model)$pval["MC_c2"]
  R2m   <- r2_ml(model)["R2_marginal"]*100
  
  ggplot(df, aes(Met_and_Cys, Mean)) +
    geom_point(aes(size=Prec), shape=21, fill="grey65",
               colour="black", stroke=.25, alpha=.6) +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(.5,4), name="Precision\n(1/SE)") +
    geom_ribbon(data=newdat,
                aes(x=Met_and_Cys, ymin=ci_lwr, ymax=ci_upr),
                fill="grey85", alpha=.5) +
    geom_line(data=newdat,
              aes(x=Met_and_Cys, y=fit),
              colour="firebrick", linewidth=.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=x_opt,
               linetype="dNaed", colour="red3",
               linewidth=.8) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Met_and_Cys)+.02*diff(range(df$Met_and_Cys)),
             y=max(df$Mean)-.03*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("Met_and_Cys = %.1f%%", x_opt),
             hjust=0, vjust=1, size=3.2) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Met_and_Cys)+.03*diff(range(df$Met_and_Cys)),
             y=min(df$Mean)+.07*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("R² = %.2f%%\nP = %.3g", R2m, p_val),
             colour="blue4", hjust=0, size=3.2) +
    labs(x="Met_and_Cys (% DM)", y="Aspartic acid (%)") +
    theme_classic(base_size=11) +
    theme(panel.border=element_rect(colour="black", fill=NA),
          axis.ticks.length=unit(0.15,"cm"),
          legend.position=c(.98,.99),
          legend.justification=c(1,1)) +
    coord_cartesian(expand=FALSE)
}

# 4. Plotting based on best model
if (best_key == "fit1") {
  print(plot_linear(best_mod, data_Asp_MC))
} else if (best_key == "fit2") {
  print(plot_quadratic(best_mod, data_Asp_MC))
} else {
  message("No significant effect of Na")
}

mods <- list(
  Linear    = fit1,
  Quadratic = fit2,
  Null      = fit0
)

aic_tab <- ms_tab                          

map_names <- c(fit0 = "Null", fit1 = "Linear", fit2 = "Quadratic")
rownames(aic_tab) <- map_names[rownames(aic_tab)]

best_row   <- rownames(aic_tab)[1]
best_label <- c(Null="Null", Linear="Linear", Quadratic="Quadratic")[best_row]


tbl_Asp_MC <- bind_rows(lapply(names(mods), function(label){
  m <- mods[[label]]
  R2m <- r2_ml(m)["R2_marginal"] * 100
  
  if (label == "Linear") {               
    p_val <- summary(m)$pval[2]              
  } else if (label == "Quadratic") {      
    p_val <- summary(m)$pval[3]             
  } else {                                
    p_val <- NA
  }
  
  AICc  <- aic_tab[label, "AICc"]
  delta <- aic_tab[label, "delta"]
  
  data.frame(
    Model         = label,
    Adjusted_R2   = round(R2m, 2),
    P_value       = signif(p_val, 3),
    AICc          = round(AICc, 2),
    Delta_AICc    = round(delta, 2),
    Selected_Model= ifelse(label == best_label, "✔", "")
  )
}))


print(tbl_Asp_MC)
##                     Model Adjusted_R2 P_value  AICc Delta_AICc Selected_Model
## R2_marginal...1    Linear        0.01   0.886 53.06       3.19

## R2_marginal...3      Null        0.00      NA 49.87       0.00              ✔

4 Publication bias and sensitivity analyses

4.1 Decline effect (Publication Year)

## Define random structure
random_structure_Ye <- list(~1 | RowID,
                            ~1 | StudyID,
                            ~1 | Region,
                            ~1 | Position)

## Model with Publication Year (Years) as moderator
Ye_VCV_REML_Asp_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_Asp_AllData,
   mods = ~ Years,
   random = random_structure_Ye,
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_Asp)
 
summary(Ye_VCV_REML_Asp_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 231; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
## -234.1395   468.2789   480.2789   500.8812   480.6573   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0317  0.1781    231     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  2.5802  1.6063    112     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  1.9717  1.4042     24     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4  0.2703  0.5199      9     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 229) = 4901469.7505, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 229) = 1.8334, p-val = 0.1771
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##          estimate        se     tval   df    pval     ci.lb     ci.ub    
## intrcpt  155.1307  112.5120   1.3788  229  0.1693  -66.5604  376.8219    
## Years     -0.0754    0.0557  -1.3540  229  0.1771   -0.1852    0.0343    
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ye_VCV_REML_Asp_mod_int)*100, 2)

##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.39          99.34
#Model without intercept for plotting
Ai_VCV_REML_Asp_mod <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_Asp_AllData,
   mods = ~ Aim -1,
   random = random_structure_aim,
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_Asp)
## Orchard plot for Aim moderator
p_Ai_VCV_REML_Asp <- orchard_plot(Ai_VCV_REML_Asp_mod, 
                                   mod = "Aim",  
                                   group = "StudyID",  
                                   xlab = "Mean Aspartic acid",
                                   cb = FALSE,
                                   angle = 0,
                                   legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                                   branch.size = 1.5)
 
print(p_Ai_VCV_REML_Asp)

4.3 Multiple_breeds (Whether multiple breeds were involved)

## Define random structure
random_structure_Mu <- list(~1 | RowID,
                            ~1 | StudyID,
                            ~1 | Region,
                            ~1 | Position)

#Model with intercept
Mu_VCV_REML_Asp_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_Asp_AllData,
   mods = ~ Multiple_breeds,
   random = random_structure_Mu,
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_Asp)
 
summary(Mu_VCV_REML_Asp_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 231; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
## -234.7060   469.4119   481.4119   502.0143   481.7903

##

## sigma^2.1  0.0317  0.1781    231     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  2.6506  1.6281    112     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  1.8715  1.3680     24     no    Region 
## sigma^2.4  0.2469  0.4969      9     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 229) = 4331373.7079, p-val < .0001

## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 229) = 0.4015, p-val = 0.5269

## Model Results:

##                     estimate      se    tval   df    pval    ci.lb   ci.ub      
## intrcpt               2.7305  0.4304  6.3437  229  <.0001   1.8824  3.5786  *** 
## Multiple_breedsYes    0.2564  0.4046  0.6337  229  0.5269  -0.5409  1.0537      
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Mu_VCV_REML_Asp_mod_int)*100, 2)

##           0.29          99.34
#Model without intercept for plotting
Mu_VCV_REML_Asp_mod <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_Asp_AllData,
   mods = ~ Multiple_breeds -1,
   random = random_structure_Mu,
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_Asp)
## Orchard plot for Multiple_breeds moderator
p_Mu_VCV_REML_Asp <- orchard_plot(Mu_VCV_REML_Asp_mod, 
                                   mod = "Multiple_breeds",  
                                   group = "StudyID",  
                                   xlab = "Mean Aspartic acid",
